title: 第25章 她的靠山来了第26章 她不好
slug: 夫人她只想修仙第370章自爆
content_zh:
华服男子彻底失语。
过了片刻，他才找回自己的声音和脑子。
“你别拿话压我，我可是为了合理利益来的！
再者，沈云熠抢了我们的东西，我们自然也可以抢回来！
掌门大人相来随性潇洒，定然不会把这件事放在心上，反过来怪我们的！”
华服男子理直气壮。
修真界本身就是的弱肉强食的舞台。
沈云熠比美人庄的护卫强，所以他可以拥有血魄草。
华服男子又比林端与颜筝强，自然也有理由抢回来。
但他不敢。
颜筝倚着身后巨石，它是整个北山宗相连的传送阵，那上面皮飞凤舞的刻了几个字——北山宗。
修界真最高的山还在颜筝身后！
他华服男子敢闯吗？
未必吧！
诚然，一个金丹干不掉他们很丢脸。
可他们身份特殊，地点也特殊。
华服男子真在北山宗宗门口杀了北山宗的亲传，大宗合力也保不住他。
颜筝看着他的眼神似乎都加上了挑衅的意味。
华服男子恨得牙痒痒，却只能挫败的认了！
他打从一开始针对的就是沈云熠，颜筝站出来说这话合情合理。

“既然如此，讨扰了。”
华服男子冷笑连连，缓缓后退。
林端奇怪地看了他一眼，由衷道：“想不到你对沈云熠够义气，他不在，你也愿意为他说话。”
颜筝一下愣住了，动作僵硬。
不是吧老铁！
我以为你是为了保护沈云熠故意瞒下来，合着你是真不知道他回来了啊！
沈云熠为了让她吃上那一口天材地宝，耗费了许多心血与急切。
前者让得到，后者让他做到。
他动作快到林端都没发现他的身影。
颜筝她知道好赖，眸中后光一闪而过，她大步向前，赶快催促：“现在，请你离开北山宗！”
“这位道友，沈道友回来了，还请告知我一声！”
华服男子直勾勾地盯着她，似笑非笑，咬牙认了！
颜筝翻了个白眼，懒得理他。
告你大坝！
赶紧滚！
content_en:
The man in rich clothes was completely speechless.
It took him a moment to find his voice and brain.
"Don't pressure me with your words, I'm here for legitimate interests!
Furthermore, if Shen Yunyi robbed our things, we can naturally rob them back!
The head of the house is so casual and carefree, so he will definitely not take this matter to heart and blame us instead! "
The man in fine clothes is confident and confident.
The world of cultivation itself is a stage where the weak and the strong prey on each other.
Shen Yunyi is stronger than the guards at Beauty Village, so he can have the Blood Grass.
The man in fine clothes was stronger than Lin Duan and Yan Zheng, so he had reason to take them back.
But he didn't dare.
Yan Zheng leaned on the huge stone behind him. It was the teleportation formation that connected the entire Beishan Sect. There were a few words carved on it - Beishan Sect - with flying phoenixes flying on the surface.
The highest mountain in Xiujie is still behind Yan Zheng!
Does this man in fine clothes dare to break in?
Not necessarily!
Admittedly, it would be embarrassing if a golden elixir couldn't kill them.
But they have a special identity and a special location.
The man in gorgeous clothes really killed the direct descendant of Beishan Sect at the gate of Beishan Sect, and even the combined efforts of all the sects could not save him.
Yan Zheng's eyes seemed to be provocative as she looked at him.
The man in the splendid suit was so angry that he could only admit it in frustration!
He was targeting Shen Yunyi from the beginning, and it was reasonable for Yan Zheng to stand up and say this.
"In that case, I'm sorry for bothering you."
The man in fine clothes sneered repeatedly and backed away slowly.
Lin Duan gave him a strange look and said sincerely: "I didn't expect you to be loyal enough to Shen Yunyi. Even if he is not here, you are willing to speak for him."
Yan Zheng was stunned and her movements were stiff.
No, old man!
I thought you concealed it deliberately to protect Shen Yunyi, but you really didn't know he was back!
Shen Yunyi spent a lot of effort and eagerness to let her take a bite of this natural treasure.
The former allows him to get it, and the latter allows him to do it.
He moved so fast that Lin Duan didn't notice him.
Yan Zheng knew what she was doing, and there was a flash of light in her eyes. She strode forward and urged: "Now, please leave the Beishan Sect!"
"This Fellow Daoist, Fellow Daoist Shen is back, please let me know!"
The man in rich clothes stared at her, half-smiling but not smiling, gritting his teeth and admitting it!
Yan Zheng rolled her eyes and was too lazy to pay attention to him.
Sue the dam!
Get out of here!
